verdict.rationale: A password manager and authenticator could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as security suggestions about stored items, so this axis applies to 2FAS. The evidence pack shows no in-product AI feature of any kind. Its agent-facing material (llms.txt, markdown mirrors, machine-readable pricing) is documentation for external AI agents, not insights generated from the user's own data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
